description: Vampire: The Masquerade — Bloodlines (GOG + Unofficial Patch 11.5, via Proton)
long: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines is an action role-playing game set in the World of Darkness, where the player is a newly turned vampire navigating clan politics in modern Los Angeles. Choices, dialogue, and chosen clan disciplines shape combat and exploration across first- and third-person play. It was developed by Troika Games and published by Activision; this build adds the community Unofficial Patch.
